status: MEASURED — dedicated admission and source currency are checked against the registered adapters. GENERAL intake reads supported source-linked facts from recognizable bureau reports without certifying an entire layout. Current UK GENERAL field support is separate from the historical Experian family. Historical samples do not certify every current report layout.

general_intake.accepts: any document that identifies a credit bureau and prints report-like content (accounts, balances, payment status, report dates, collections, inquiries, public records)
general_intake.does_not_require: a known layout, pinned specimen digest, official specimen or exact heading sequence
general_intake.extraction: own report reference date, creditor and collection agency, masked account and member references, balances, past due, credit limit, payment amount, account type, status, responsibility, supported account dates and dated readable payment-history cells with each field's source locations
general_intake.assessments: active common-error checklist checks supplied by each record's own source-linked facts, source-supported account pairs and owned earlier-report comparison; jurisdiction-specific reporting periods remain limited to accepted applicable mappings; court deadlines are consumer information only
general_intake.jurisdiction_scope: all 82 selected jurisdictions; shared checks run only when the particular report supplies the needed facts and source evidence

current_field_contracts.boundary: Supported published consumer captions and their meanings on GENERAL; no complete current bureau PDF geometry, populated specimen or TransUnion history-code interpretation is certified.

general_intake.labels: example-backed extraction, never a validated presentation family; no claim of authenticity or universal accuracy
general_intake.refusals: UNRELATED_DOCUMENT for a clearly unrelated document, UNREADABLE_DOCUMENT for a report that could not be read
